description: This file contains a serializer implementation for the .NET Type class within the Orleans.Serialization framework. It handles serialization and deserialization of Type objects, including special handling for well-known, referenced, and encoded types. The class implements interfaces for serializing fields and derived type codecs, managing the writing and reading of Type metadata in a custom binary format.

classes.name: TypeSerializerCodec
classes.description: A serializer for the .NET Type class, capable of writing and reading type metadata with support for well-known, referenced, and encoded types within the Orleans serialization framework.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Serializes a Type object into the writer, with handling for reference and type encoding.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Deserializes a Type object from the reader, interpreting type information according to the schema type.
